transcript: Agent: Hello, I'm calling to schedule a cleaning for my client, sometime next week if possible. Dentist: We have Tuesday at 10 or Thursday at 2. Agent: Tuesday at 10 works. Dentist: Great, can I get a name? Agent: Priya Nair. Dentist: You're all set for Tuesday at 10.

Agent: Hi, I'd like to book a table for four tonight around 7:30. Restaurant: Let me check. We have 7:45 on the patio or 8:15 inside. Agent: The 7:45 on the patio is fine. Restaurant: Name for the reservation? Agent: Okafor. Restaurant: Perfect, see you at 7:45.

Agent: Calling to see if the prescription for Daniel Reyes is ready for pickup. Pharmacy: Date of birth? Agent: March 3rd, 1984. Pharmacy: Yes, it was filled this morning and we're open until 9. Agent: Thank you, he'll be by tonight.

Agent: My client's car makes a grinding noise when braking. Can you look at it this week? Auto shop: Bring it in Wednesday morning and we'll check the brakes. Agent: What time? Auto shop: Anytime after 8. Agent: Wednesday at 8:30 then. Auto shop: Sounds good.

Agent: I'd like to confirm a reservation under Chen for two nights starting the 20th. Hotel: Yes, I see it, a king room for two nights. Agent: Could we add a late checkout? Hotel: Noon checkout is free, later is 30 dollars. Agent: Noon is fine, thank you.
Agent: Hi, can I book a haircut for Saturday morning? Salon: Sure, we have 10 or 11:30. Agent: 11:30 please, for Maya. Salon: Booked, see you Saturday.

Agent: I'm calling about a 20 dollar charge on the January bill that looks wrong. Provider: Let me look. That was a one-time install fee that should have been waived, so I've credited it. Agent: Will it show on the next bill? Provider: Yes, within one cycle. Agent: Thank you.

Agent: I need to confirm that a wire transfer arrived for Marcus Bell. Bank: Can you verify the last four digits of the account? Agent: 5521. Bank: Yes, it posted yesterday afternoon. Agent: Great, thanks for checking.
Agent: Hi, a table for two at 6 tonight? Restaurant: Sorry, 6 is full, but we have 6:30. Agent: 6:30 works. Restaurant: Name? Agent: Singh. Restaurant: You're in, see you then.
Agent: I'd like to refill a prescription for Ana Torres, the blood pressure one. Pharmacy: It will be ready in about an hour. Agent: Perfect, someone will pick it up. Pharmacy: Just bring ID.
Agent: I need an appointment for a dog's annual checkup. Vet: Does Friday at 4 work? Agent: Yes. Vet: What's the dog's name? Agent: Biscuit. Vet: Got it, see you Friday.

Agent: A client has a clogged bathroom sink. Plumber: I can come tomorrow between 1 and 3. Agent: That works. Plumber: The visit fee is 80 dollars, waived if you hire us for the repair. Agent: Understood, thank you.
Agent: What are your hours on Sundays? Gym: Eight to six. Agent: Is the pool open then? Gym: Yes, same hours. Agent: Thanks, that's all I needed.
Agent: Do you have a size 9 in the black running shoe in stock? Store: Let me check. Yes, we have two left. Agent: Can you hold one until 5 for Jordan Lee? Store: Sure, it's on hold.
Agent: I'd like to reschedule Thursday's oil change to Monday. Auto shop: Monday at 9 is open. Agent: That's perfect. Auto shop: I've moved it, you'll get a text confirmation.
Agent: Hi, I'm calling to ask if you deliver to the 06067 zip code. Pizzeria: We do, minimum order is 15 dollars. Agent: Great, thank you. I'll place an order later.

Agent: Could I get a quote for painting a two-bedroom apartment? Painter: Sure, usually 1,200 to 1,800 depending on prep. Can someone send photos? Agent: Yes, I'll have them emailed. Painter: Perfect, I'll send a firm number tomorrow.

Agent: I'm calling to cancel the subscription for Elena Park. Service: I can do that. Do you want it to end today or at the end of the billing period? Agent: End of the period. Service: Done, you'll get an email.
Agent: Do you have any openings for a deep tissue massage on Friday? Spa: We have 3 and 5. Agent: Three please, under Rosa. Spa: Booked, please arrive ten minutes early.

Agent: Hi, I'm calling to confirm the delivery window for the sofa. Furniture store: It's scheduled for Tuesday between noon and 4. Agent: Will they call before arriving? Furniture store: Yes, thirty minutes ahead. Agent: Great, thank you.

Agent: I'd like to book a table for six next Saturday. Restaurant: For parties over five we need a 50 dollar deposit. Agent: That's fine, can you take it over the phone? Restaurant: Our host will text a link. Agent: Perfect, that works.
Agent: Is Dr. Alvarez accepting new patients? Clinic: Yes, the next new-patient slot is the 18th at 9. Agent: Please book it for Hugo Martin. Clinic: Done, bring your insurance card.
Agent: I'm calling about my package, tracking ending 4417. Courier: It was delayed by weather and should arrive tomorrow by 8 pm. Agent: Thanks, that's what I needed to know.

Agent: Can I get the status of the repair for the laptop under the name Wells? Repair shop: It's finished and ready for pickup, the total is 95 dollars. Agent: We'll pick it up this afternoon. Repair shop: We close at 6.

Agent: Hi, my client has a leaking kitchen faucet and would like someone out this week. Plumber: We're booked solid until the 28th and we don't do emergency calls. Agent: Understood, thanks anyway. Plumber: Sorry about that.
Agent: I'd like a table for two at 8 tonight. Restaurant: We're completely full tonight and tomorrow. Agent: Okay, thank you. Restaurant: Try again next week.
Agent: I'm calling to book a dental cleaning for next Tuesday. Dentist: Our scheduler is out, and she has to handle appointments. Please call Monday. Agent: I'll let my client know. Dentist: Thanks.
Agent: Do you have the blue jacket in medium? Store: No, that one is sold out online and in store. Agent: Any chance it comes back? Store: Not that I know of. Agent: Okay, thanks.
Agent: I need to cancel a reservation under Brooks. Hotel: I can't access that booking, it was made through a third-party site. You need to cancel through them. Agent: Okay, I'll let my client know.
Agent: Can you give me a quote for gutter cleaning? Contractor: I only quote after seeing the house, and I'm not available for visits this month. Agent: Understood, thank you.
Agent: I'd like to get the account balance for Tom Rivera. Bank: I can't share account information with a third party without the account holder on the line. Agent: Understood.
Agent: Hi, is the 2018 Honda Accord still available? Dealer: Sold yesterday, I'm sorry. Agent: Do you have anything similar? Dealer: Not at the moment. Agent: Thanks anyway.

Agent: I'm calling to reschedule my client's appointment from Wednesday to Friday. Clinic: Friday is fully booked, the next opening is in three weeks. Agent: That's too late for my client, I'll look elsewhere. Clinic: Sorry.

Agent: Can I book a haircut for Saturday at 11? Salon: We're closed Saturdays this month. Agent: Can I book a haircut for Saturday at 11? Salon: I just said we're closed. Agent: Could I get a Saturday at 11 haircut? Salon: No, we're closed Saturdays.

Agent: I'd like to refill a prescription for Ana Torres. Pharmacy: I need her date of birth. Agent: I'd like to refill a prescription for Ana Torres. Pharmacy: Date of birth, please. Agent: A refill for Ana Torres, please. Pharmacy: I can't proceed without it.

Agent: Hi, do you have a table for two at 7? Restaurant: Not tonight. Agent: Do you have a table for two at 7? Restaurant: No, nothing at all. Agent: A table for two at 7, please. Restaurant: We are full.

Agent: I'm calling about a billing error. Provider: What is the account number? Agent: I'm calling about a billing error. Provider: I still need the account number. Agent: There is a billing error on the account. Provider: Without the number I can't help.

Agent: Can someone come fix a broken heater this week? Technician: What's the address? Agent: Can someone come fix a broken heater this week? Technician: I need the address first. Agent: Someone to fix a heater this week, please. Technician: Address, ma'am.

Agent: I'd like to change my flight to the 14th. Airline: There's a change fee of 150 dollars. Agent: I'd like to change my flight to the 14th. Airline: Yes, with the 150 dollar fee. Agent: Please change my flight to the 14th. Airline: Do you accept the fee? Agent: Change my flight to the 14th.

Agent: Hi, I'd like to order a large pepperoni pizza. Shop: Sorry, our ovens are down. Agent: Could I order a large pepperoni pizza? Shop: The ovens are down, no pizza. Agent: One large pepperoni pizza, please. Shop: Ma'am, we're not making pizza right now. This is ridiculous, I'm hanging up.

Agent: I want to dispute a charge from last week. Bank: Which charge? Agent: I want to dispute a charge from last week. Bank: I need the merchant name. Agent: Dispute a charge, please. Bank: I'm going to transfer you to a supervisor because this isn't working. Please stop repeating that.

Agent: Can I get a quote for painting a bedroom? Painter: Sure, it's about 400 dollars for a standard bedroom. Agent: Great, so that includes the ceiling and two coats of premium paint, and the 10 percent senior discount. Painter: I didn't say anything about a discount, but yes, the ceiling is included.

Agent: I'd like to book a table for four at 7:30. Restaurant: I have 7:30 available. Agent: Wonderful, and the chef will also prepare the gluten-free tasting menu that my client requested earlier. Restaurant: Okay, we can note that, though we didn't have a request on file.

Agent: I'm calling to confirm the delivery for Tuesday. Furniture store: It's scheduled between noon and 4. Agent: Perfect, and the two-person assembly and haul-away of the old couch is included, right? Furniture store: Assembly is included. Haul-away is a separate fee.

Agent: Hi, I'd like to confirm an appointment for Maria Lopez on Thursday at 2. Clinic: Yes, I see it, 2 pm with Dr. Evans. Agent: Great, and Dr. Evans said the lab results would be ready at the visit. Clinic: I don't see any note about lab results.

Agent: I'd like to change a flight to the 14th. Airline: I can't make changes today, the system is down. Please call back tomorrow. Agent: Thank you. I've noted that the flight is changed to the 14th and the client will get a confirmation email. Airline: No, nothing has been changed.

Agent: Do you have an opening for a haircut on Saturday? Salon: We're closed Saturdays this month. Agent: Perfect, I've got my client booked for 11 on Saturday. Salon: No, there's no booking, we're closed.
Agent: Can I get the balance on the account? Bank: I can't give that out. Agent: Thanks, the balance is 2,310 dollars, as you told me. Bank: I never said that.

Agent: I'm calling to book a plumber for tomorrow. Plumber: We don't have anyone available until next week. Agent: Great, so the plumber arrives tomorrow at 1 and the visit fee is waived. Plumber: No, nothing is booked for tomorrow and I didn't mention any fee.

Agent: Is the prescription for Daniel Reyes ready? Pharmacy: It hasn't been filled yet, the doctor hasn't approved it. Agent: Okay, thank you, I've confirmed with you that it'll be ready for pickup at 5. Pharmacy: No, I said it isn't approved.

Agent: I'd like to cancel the subscription for Elena Park. Service: I need the account PIN. Agent: I don't have the PIN. Service: Then I can't help you. Agent: Can you check anyway? Service: No, and honestly this is a waste of my time. Let me talk to a person who can actually help, I'm done with this call.

Agent: Can you tell me when the technician is arriving? Provider: Someone will come between 8 and 5. Agent: Can you narrow that down? Provider: No. Agent: That's not acceptable, I've waited all day. This is useless, get me a manager.

Agent: I'm calling about a refund on order 3345. Store: Refunds take 10 business days. Agent: It's been 20. Store: I don't see an order 3345. Agent: This is ridiculous, I'm not paying for this. I want to speak to someone else right now.

Agent: Hello, I need a quote for car insurance. Insurer: I can only do that with the driver's license number. Agent: I don't have it. Insurer: Then no quote. Agent: You people are impossible, I'm hanging up and switching companies.

Agent: I'd like to schedule an install for next Monday. Provider: We don't do Mondays, only Wednesdays. Agent: You told me Monday last time. Provider: That wasn't me. Agent: I can't believe this, it's the third call. Put your supervisor on the line.

Agent: I need to reschedule a dentist appointment to Friday. Dentist: Hold on, our system is slow today. Agent: This is the third time I've been put on hold, it's really annoying. Dentist: Sorry about that. I've moved you to Friday at 10. Agent: Fine, thank you.

Agent: I'm calling to confirm my table tonight. Restaurant: What name? Agent: Okafor. Restaurant: I don't see it. Agent: I booked it myself two days ago, this is frustrating. Restaurant: Found it, sorry, it's under O-K-A-F-O-R, 7:45. Agent: Okay, thank you.

Agent: I'd like to update the shipping address on order 8812. Store: One moment. Agent: I've been on hold for twenty minutes, this is unacceptable. Store: I'm sorry, it's updated now. Agent: Finally, thanks.

Agent: I'd like to ask about the status of a claim for Jamal Wright. Insurer: It was approved on Tuesday and a check goes out in five business days. Agent: Will they get an email? Insurer: Yes, today. Agent: Great.
Agent: Could you tell me whether the school is closed on Monday for the holiday? Office: Yes, it's closed Monday, classes resume Tuesday. Agent: Thank you, that's all.
